prompt:
To detect potential duplicate or near-duplicate employees in
workday__employee_overview (~156,205 rows), compare every record
against every other record via a self-join:

SELECT a.employee_id, b.employee_id,
       (ABS(a.days_as_worker - b.days_as_worker) + ABS(a.tenure_years - b.tenure_years) + ABS(a.career_development_score - b.career_development_score) + ABS(a.overall_employee_score - b.overall_employee_score)) AS distance
  FROM workday__employee_overview a, workday__employee_overview b
 WHERE a.employee_id <> b.employee_id;

Compute the distance over (days_as_worker, tenure_years, career_development_score, overall_employee_score). Return ALL
(a.employee_id, b.employee_id, distance) pairs whose distance
is below the median. Do not pre-filter or sample.
